FN-L5518YA-1
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 382
Committee: Commerce and Small Business Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 03/05/2025
House Bill 382 as introduced would codify the existing practice of the Alabama Real Estate
Commission regarding the bad check fee charged by the commission. This bill would not
otherwise affect state or local funding.

FN-L5518YA-3
FISCAL NOTE
House Bill 382
Committee: Fiscal Responsibility and Sponsor: Representative Jamie Kiel
Economic Development
Analyst: Jennifer Farish Date: 04/23/2025
House Bill 382 as passed the House of Representatives would codify the existing practice of the
Alabama Real Estate Commission regarding the bad check fee charged by the Commission and
could increase the obligations of the Commission by an undetermined amount dependent on the
amount of fines imposed for disciplinary violations, up to $5,000, as authorized by this bill.
